data: Which retrieval method results in the highest map score?

The question asks which retrieval method results in the highest map score. From the caption, we know that the figure shows the retrieval results of the tf.idf weighted link translations combined with different concept models. The lines represent different methods, and the y-axis represents the map score. 

Looking at the graph, the line labeled "α lda + (1 - α) links" appears to reach the highest point on the y-axis compared to the other lines. This suggests that this method results in the highest map score. Therefore, the answer is "α lda + (1 - α) links".
